title: Force
subtitle: 本課限定語境：force = make someone do something, especially against their will or because circums
description: 本課限定語境：force = make someone do something, especially against their will or because circumstances leave little choice · 「迫使／強迫／逼使」

words.note: 正式地表示某人因外在力量、規則或情況而不得不做某事。
words.example: The evidence compelled him to admit the truth.

exercises.original: The evidence forced him to admit that the figures were inaccurate.
exercises.zh: 證據迫使他承認數據不準確。
exercises.upgrade: The evidence compelled him to admit that the figures were inaccurate.

options.explanation: 正式書面語中，強而有力的 evidence 使人不得不承認，最自然。
通常需要人或社會壓力作主語，比 evidence 不自然。
通常帶規則／責任感，不如 compelled 適合 evidence。
表示說服，保留自願成分。

exercises.original: The court ruling forced the company to change its policy.
exercises.zh: 法院裁決迫使公司改變政策。
exercises.upgrade: The court ruling compelled the company to change its policy.

options.explanation: 法院裁決帶正式、不可抗拒的法律壓力。
也很合理，但更中性地表示法律要求。
較少用 court ruling 作「施壓者」。
現在分詞／形容詞，時態不合。

exercises.original: Circumstances forced her to reconsider her plans.
exercises.zh: 情況迫使她重新考慮計劃。
exercises.upgrade: Circumstances compelled her to reconsider her plans.

options.explanation: 正式而中性地表示情況令她不得不重新考慮。
也接近，但更有「壓力驅使」意味。
通常需要具體規則／條件要求。

words.note: 非常常見的使役動詞，可表示令某人做某事。
words.example: The teacher made the students rewrite the paragraph.
words.exampleZh: 老師要學生重寫那一段。

exercises.original: The teacher forced the students to rewrite the paragraph.
exercises.zh: 老師要學生重寫那一段。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher made the students rewrite the paragraph.

options.explanation: make someone do something 是標準使役結構。
也可，但語氣更正式、更強。
也可，但要用 obliged the students to rewrite。
更像持續施壓，不一定直接命令。
主動句中 make 後不加 to。

exercises.original: The noise forced everyone to leave the room.
exercises.zh: 噪音令所有人離開房間。
exercises.upgrade: The noise made everyone leave the room.

options.explanation: 也可說 drove everyone out of the room，但句法需要改寫。
噪音不會以人際方式「施壓」。

exercises.original: The unexpected delay forced us to change the schedule.
exercises.zh: 突如其來的延誤令我們改變時間表。
exercises.upgrade: The unexpected delay made us change the schedule.

options.explanation: 最簡單自然地表示延誤造成改變。
也很適合，但更自然改寫成 necessitated a change to the schedule。

words.note: 表示利用威脅、恐嚇、不當壓力等使某人做本來不願意做的事。
words.example: They were coerced into signing the agreement.

exercises.original: They forced him to sign the document by threatening to dismiss him.
exercises.zh: 他們以解僱作威脅，迫使他簽署文件。
exercises.upgrade: They coerced him into signing the document.

options.explanation: threatening dismissal 是明確脅迫手段。
也可表示被迫，但沒有像 coerce 那樣突出威脅／不當壓力。
也接近，但通常強度略低。

exercises.original: The victims were forced into handing over their passwords.
exercises.zh: 受害者被脅迫交出密碼。
exercises.upgrade: The victims were coerced into handing over their passwords.

options.explanation: into doing + victims 強烈暗示非自願和不當壓力。
也可，但不一定達到 coercion 的強度。
也很接近，但較正式中性。
像合法規定，不符合受害者語境。

exercises.original: She said she had been forced to agree because of repeated threats.
exercises.zh: 她說自己因多次威脅而被迫同意。
exercises.upgrade: She said she had been coerced into agreeing.

options.explanation: 也可能，但比 coerced 稍弱。
也可，但不特別指出不當手段。
表示改變想法，不是被威脅。

words.note: 表示因規則、責任、情況或禮貌而不得不做某事。
words.example: The regulations oblige employers to provide safety equipment.
words.exampleZh: 規例要求僱主提供安全設備。

exercises.original: The regulations force employers to provide protective equipment.
exercises.zh: 規例要求僱主提供防護設備。
exercises.upgrade: The regulations oblige employers to provide protective equipment.

options.explanation: 規則使僱主承擔明確義務。
也非常自然，且更中性制度化。
規例通常不是人際「施壓」。

exercises.original: The contract forced both parties to keep the information confidential.
exercises.zh: 合約使雙方有義務保密。
exercises.upgrade: The contract obliged both parties to keep the information confidential.

options.explanation: contract + duty 是典型義務語境。
較強，可用但少了義務語感。

exercises.original: The rules force applicants to disclose any conflicts of interest.
exercises.zh: 規則要求申請人披露任何利益衝突。
exercises.upgrade: The rules oblige applicants to disclose any conflicts of interest.

words.note: 表示規則、制度、工作或情況要求某人必須做某事。
words.example: The law requires drivers to wear seat belts.
words.exampleZh: 法律規定駕駛者必須佩戴安全帶。

exercises.original: The law forces drivers to wear seat belts.
exercises.zh: 法律規定駕駛者必須佩戴安全帶。
exercises.upgrade: The law requires drivers to wear seat belts.

options.explanation: 制度／法律要求最自然、最中性。
也非常接近，強調法律義務。

exercises.original: The course forces students to complete two practical assessments.
exercises.zh: 課程規定學生必須完成兩項實務評核。
exercises.upgrade: The course requires students to complete two practical assessments.

options.explanation: 課程規定／條件最適合 require。
語法可用，但更像老師或人直接使役。
只是促使，不是制度要求。

exercises.original: The job forces employees to work occasional weekends.
exercises.zh: 這份工作要求員工偶爾週末上班。
exercises.upgrade: The job requires employees to work occasional weekends.

options.explanation: 職位條件／工作要求最自然。

words.note: 表示透過社會、心理、經濟或人際壓力令某人做某事。
words.example: They pressured him into changing his decision.
words.exampleZh: 他們向他施壓，逼使他改變決定。

exercises.original: They forced him to change his decision by repeatedly criticizing him.
exercises.zh: 他們不斷批評他，施壓逼他改變決定。
exercises.upgrade: They pressured him into changing his decision.

options.explanation: repeated criticism 是典型心理／人際壓力。
如果有威脅或更強不當手段才更精確。
表示以理由說服，而不是施壓。

exercises.original: The manager forced staff to work late by suggesting their jobs were at risk.
exercises.zh: 經理暗示員工工作不保，施壓要求他們加班。
exercises.upgrade: The manager pressured staff to work late.

options.explanation: 用就業風險暗示施加心理壓力。
也可能成立，尤其若威脅明確；語氣更強。
聽起來像正常工作規定，弱化了不當壓力。
可表結果，但沒有施壓方式。

exercises.original: Family expectations forced her to choose a career she did not really want.
exercises.zh: 家庭期望施壓令她選擇了自己其實不想要的職業。
exercises.upgrade: Family expectations pressured her into choosing a career she did not really want.

options.explanation: 社會／家庭期待造成心理壓力，最自然。
也接近，但稍口語、強度較低。
家庭期望不是制度規定。
保留較多自願接受理由的意味。

words.note: 表示某種情況、需求、恐懼或壓力促使某人採取行動。
words.example: Rising costs drove the company to raise prices.
words.exampleZh: 成本上升迫使公司加價。

exercises.original: Rising costs forced the company to raise prices.
exercises.zh: 成本上升迫使公司提高價格。
exercises.upgrade: Rising costs drove the company to raise prices.

options.explanation: 經濟壓力促使行動，是非常自然搭配。
較像規則要求，不如 drive 表達情況壓力。

exercises.original: Fear of losing customers forced the business to improve its service.
exercises.zh: 害怕失去顧客迫使企業改善服務。
exercises.upgrade: Fear of losing customers drove the business to improve its service.

options.explanation: fear 作為內在／外在動因驅使行動，很自然。

exercises.original: Competition forced firms to innovate more quickly.
exercises.zh: 競爭迫使企業更快創新。
exercises.upgrade: Competition drove firms to innovate more quickly.

options.explanation: 市場競爭是典型外在驅動因素。
也可說 competition pressured firms，但 drive 更自然地表達因果驅動。

words.note: 表示強烈鼓勵、施壓或迫使某人採取某種行動。
words.example: The deadline pushed the team to work faster.
words.exampleZh: 限期逼使團隊加快工作。

exercises.original: The deadline forced the team to work faster.
exercises.zh: 限期逼使團隊加快工作。
exercises.upgrade: The deadline pushed the team to work faster.

options.explanation: deadline 施加壓力促使加快，口語自然。
也很自然，通常更強調因果驅使。
deadline 本身不是規則主體。

exercises.original: Poor sales forced the company to rethink its strategy.
exercises.zh: 銷售不佳逼使公司重新思考策略。
exercises.upgrade: Poor sales pushed the company to rethink its strategy.

options.explanation: 結果不佳造成壓力，促使公司改變。

exercises.original: The criticism forced the organization to respond publicly.
exercises.zh: 批評逼使機構公開回應。
exercises.upgrade: The criticism pushed the organization to respond publicly.

options.explanation: 批評帶來壓力並促使行動。
也很接近，但通常更自然說 pressure from critics pressured...，避免同源重複。
批評未必提供說服理由。

words.word: Leave someone no choice but to
words.note: 非常清楚地表達「沒有其他實際選擇」。
words.example: The flooding left residents no choice but to evacuate.
words.exampleZh: 水災令居民別無選擇，只能撤離。

exercises.original: The flooding forced residents to evacuate immediately.
exercises.zh: 水災令居民別無選擇，只能立即撤離。
exercises.upgrade: The flooding left residents no choice but to evacuate immediately.
exercises.answer: left residents no choice but to evacuate

options.text: left residents no choice but to evacuate
options.explanation: 天災令其他選項實際消失，最精確。
也很自然，但較正式、簡潔。

exercises.original: The broken heating system forced the school to close for the day.
exercises.zh: 暖氣系統故障令學校別無選擇，只能停課一天。
exercises.upgrade: The broken heating system left the school no choice but to close for the day.
exercises.answer: left the school no choice but to close

options.text: left the school no choice but to close
options.explanation: 設備故障令實際選擇被排除。
若有安全規例明確要求可用，但題句只說情況本身。

options.text: left the school no choice closing
options.explanation: 固定結構需要 but to + verb。

exercises.original: A lack of funding forced the project team to reduce the scope.
exercises.zh: 資金不足令項目團隊別無選擇，只能縮減範圍。
exercises.upgrade: A lack of funding left the team no choice but to reduce the scope.
exercises.answer: left the team no choice but to reduce

options.text: left the team no choice but to reduce
options.explanation: 資源不足直接消除其他可行選項。
也很自然，但不如 target 明確表達「別無選擇」。

options.text: left no choice to the team but reducing
options.explanation: 固定語序與動詞形式不對。

words.note: 表示某個情況使某個行動變得必要。
words.exampleZh: 損壞令大規模維修成為必要。

exercises.original: The damage forced the building to undergo extensive repairs.
exercises.zh: 損壞令大規模維修成為必要。
exercises.upgrade: The damage necessitated extensive repairs.

options.explanation: situation → action becomes necessary，是典型結構。
通常需要「compel someone to do」，直接配 repairs 不自然。
也可說 required extensive repairs，很接近。
損壞不會以人際方式施壓。

exercises.original: The change in law forced the company to revise its contracts.
exercises.zh: 法律改變令公司有必要修改合約。
exercises.upgrade: The change in law necessitated revisions to the company's contracts.

options.explanation: 這裡自然改寫成「法律變動使修改合約成為必要」。
若保持原句 compelled the company to revise 也可。
要有受詞 obliged the company to...。
法律變動不是人際施壓。
形容詞，不能作主要動詞。

exercises.original: The unexpected increase in demand forced the factory to add a second shift.
exercises.zh: 需求意外上升令工廠有必要增加第二更。
exercises.upgrade: The unexpected increase in demand necessitated a second shift at the factory.

options.explanation: 需求變化令額外班次成為必要，最自然。
也可說 drove the factory to add...，偏因果驅動。
也接近，但 necessitated 更正式地表示「因此成為必要」。

falseSynonyms.zh: 說服 ≠ 強迫 persuade 是令某人自願同意； force 是即使不願意也不得不做。
鼓勵 ≠ 迫使 encourage 只是給支持／動力，對方仍然可以拒絕。
要求／詢問 ≠ 強迫 ask 可以被拒絕。
命令 ≠ 必然成功迫使 order 是發出命令； force 強調對方實際沒有選擇或被迫行動。
使相信 ≠ 強迫 convince 主要改變想法或信念。
威脅 ≠ 強迫本身 threaten 可以是 coercion 的手段，但不等於整個「迫使」概念。
詞性陷阱 - force = 動詞／名詞 - forced = 被迫的；強制的 - forcibly = 強行地
詞形與概念不同 - compel = 迫使（動詞） - compulsory = 強制性的（形容詞） - compulsion = 強迫／衝動（名詞）
